source_method: unmodified ThreHook(mode='var', level='channel').forward moments and ThreHook.get_scale_from_var
source_nan_policy: after 100 source iterations, ThreHook replaces NaN scale entries with the initial scale (1.0); mask/count are instrumented without changing source arithmetic
converter_nonpositive_policy: pinned converter maps finite negative scale to zero; zero remains zero; no epsilon repair

config_evidence.conversion_scale_semantics: for ResNet MTH converter, raw ThreHook.scale is clamped by scale>=0 and passed directly as neuron thresh; threshold_scale is not read by converter.py
config_evidence.adaptation_note: this graph protocol explicitly uses channel level; the pinned ImageNet example config defaults to 4 thresholds and threshold_scale 1, so 8-level graph use is an adaptation, not a literal ImageNet endpoint reproduction
